title: random facts, MAXIMUM damage 💀 | part 6
description: No theme. No mercy. Five facts. Part 7 tomorrow.
facts: The first photograph ever taken needed about eight hours of exposure.
There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
The Eiffel Tower grows about fifteen centimeters taller every summer.
A lightning bolt is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
outro: Follow for part seven. The damage continues.
